title: GHOST reliance record
description: Draft schema interpreting GHOST v1.0 section 7.1: when a principal follows a rung 2 recommendation, the operator SHOULD record the counsel, the action, and the outcome. The substrate of calibration.

grade.description: The three counsel grades (2). A recommendation is permitted only at rung 2 with provenance (6.1, 6.2).

kind.description: 6.2: distinguish "the method says" from "I infer from the method".

citation.description: The corpus claim, cited into the manifest.

provenance.description: Required in practice for grade recommendation (GH-08); the schema states the shape, the implementation enforces the rung rule.

action.description: What the principal actually did. Every action on counsel is a human decision (6.5).

outcome.description: What happened; may be recorded later than the action.
